name: PreciTaste
oneLiner: AI kitchen management platform that forecasts demand and tells crews what to prep, cook and order, using POS data and computer vision.
bestFor: QSR and fast-casual chains and franchisees (including bakery-case concepts) that want to cut prep waste and stockouts.

customers.name: Mac Haik Restaurant Group (First Watch franchisee)

updates.text: Partnership with PAR Technology that pulls historical sales data from PAR's POS automatically to speed up onboarding for PreciTaste's forecasting tools.
Dunkin' franchisee Bluemont Group rolled out PreciTaste's Do'Cast AI donut and Munchkin ordering, which combines demand forecasting with camera-based shelf monitoring, across 90+ locations.
Closed a seven-figure revenue-based financing from Round2 Capital to fund rollout and product expansion in Europe.

features: Prep Assistant: daily prep lists from location-level demand forecasts
Planner Assistant: production planning across the day
Station Assistant: real-time cook guidance at the line
Computer vision that monitors ingredient levels and display cases
Automated bakery/donut ordering (Do'Cast) from forecasts and shelf images
Forecasts that account for sales trends, weather, seasonality and local events
POS integrations including PAR and Toast

pricing.text: Custom pricing; PreciTaste does not publish prices.

notes: Chipotle piloted PreciTaste's kitchen management system in 2022 (https://newsroom.chipotle.com/2022-09-27-CHIPOTLE-PILOTS-ADVANCED-TECHNOLOGY-TO-ENHANCE-THE-EMPLOYEE-AND-GUEST-EXPERIENCE), but no current Chipotle deployment was confirmed, so Chipotle is left out of customers; describe it only as a 2022 pilot if used. Mac Haik's 90%+ prep-accuracy figure is from a vendor/Intel case study. Round2 financing amount not disclosed ('seven-figure'). Toast integration documented at https://intercom.help/toast-central/en/articles/14487853-get-started-with-the-precitaste-integration. Fast Casual also covered honeygrow and Dig/Urbanbelly using AI for prep, but the PreciTaste link could not be confirmed from search snippets.
